verdict.rationale: The pack shows only adjacent guardrail building blocks: IAM policy types including permissions boundaries, budget actions that can automatically apply a deny-provisioning IAM policy within an account, and temporary role credentials. Nothing documents multi-account or organizational-unit isolation patterns or sandbox account setups that keep experiments away from prod. Missing for 10: documented multi-account/org-unit isolation patterns, sandbox account guidance, org-level guardrails (e.g. service control policies), independent or hands-on corroboration.
